entries.mem0ai/mem0: This universal memory layer provides multi-level storage for user, session, and agent states using temporal reasoning and multi-signal retrieval. It is an official Hermes Agent provider available as a managed cloud service or an Apache-2.0 self-hosted SDK.
entries.volcengine/OpenViking: OpenViking organizes context as a virtual filesystem using viking:// URIs and a three-tier loading system to reduce token consumption. This official provider offers observable retrieval trajectories and demonstrated significant task-completion gains in LoCoMo10 benchmarks.
entries.topoteretes/cognee: Cognee implements a self-hosted knowledge graph engine to provide agents with persistent long-term memory across sessions. It combines vector embeddings with graph-based reasoning and offers clients for Python, Rust, and TypeScript.
entries.garrytan/gbrain: This opinionated agent brain builds knowledge graphs using typed edges without requiring LLM calls for graph construction. It generates cited prose answers with explicit gap analysis while maintaining scoped institutional memory through per-user data isolation.
entries.supermemoryai/supermemory: An official Hermes provider, SuperMemory features a custom vector graph engine that supports sub-300ms recall and byte-level deduplication for prompt-cache discounts. It automates fact extraction and user profiling through connectors for platforms like Google Drive, Notion, and GitHub.
entries.vectorize-io/hindsight: Hindsight enables long-term retain, recall, and reflect workflows across more than 25 LLM providers. It is deployable via Docker, Kubernetes, or managed cloud and supports integration through Python, Node.js, and Go libraries.
entries.plastic-labs/honcho: Honcho serves as the upstream library for the Hermes self-hosted wrapper, providing core service logic via a FastAPI server. It offers SDKs in Python and TypeScript to manage sessions and peers across managed or local deployments.
entries.campfirein/byterover-cli: This official provider treats memory as a git repository, utilizing a five-tier retrieval system where four tiers are non-LLM for sub-100ms performance. It features an interactive TUI and version control operations like commit and merge for managing plain markdown context trees.
entries.mnemosyne-oss/mnemosyne: Mnemosyne is a zero-dependency memory system that uses a single SQLite database for local storage and sub-millisecond performance. It integrates via MCP, Python SDK, or OpenWebUI and requires only a single pure-Python dependency.
entries.ClaudioDrews/memory-os: This seven-layer memory system utilizes Qdrant, Redis, and SQLite to manage vector searches, structured facts, and an auto-curated wiki. It employs a Ground Truth hierarchy to ensure the agent prioritizes specific injected contexts during execution.
entries.greyhaven-ai/autocontext: AutoContext is a recursive self-improving harness that produces filesystem-first artifacts like context bundles and playbooks. It features outcome-gated promotion and ablation-backed attribution to refine context changes for complex tasks.
entries.stephenschoettler/hermes-lcm: This Lossless Context Management plugin uses a DAG-based engine and SQLite with FTS metadata to ensure no messages are lost. It provides specific agent tools for searching and expanding compacted material within the Hermes Agent environment.
entries.elkimek/honcho-self-hosted: This self-hosted backend provides Hermes Agent with private cross-session memory persistence. It supports any OpenAI-compatible LLM or local inference server and includes an automated setup script for Docker, PostgreSQL, and Redis.
entries.Signet-AI/signetai: Signet-AI is a local-first identity and memory layer that offers portable state across Hermes Agent and other MCP clients. It achieves 97.6% LongMemEval accuracy and imports data from sources like Obsidian, Discord, and GitHub.
entries.plur-ai/plur: Plur implements a shared memory layer using human-readable YAML files and a hybrid search combining BM25 with local embeddings. It integrates with MCP tools to provide a consistent engram format for multi-agent systems.
entries.yoloshii/ClawMem: ClawMem is an on-device context engine that operates locally without cloud dependencies or API keys. It utilizes hybrid retrieval, including vector search and BM25, to serve agents via MCP and specialized plugins.
entries.EfficientContext/ContextPilot: This optimization tool reduces prefill latency by 1.5–3× and saves up to 36% of tokens through block reordering and deduplication. It features native plugin support for the Hermes Agent ecosystem to accelerate long-context inference.
entries.Sibyl-Labs/Sibyl-Memory: Sibyl-Memory is a file-based long-term memory system that uses SQLite with FTS5 search instead of vector databases. The five-package plugin family includes a dedicated Hermes adapter and a LangGraph BaseStore.
entries.yantrikos/yantrikdb-hermes-plugin: This plugin provides explainable recall by attaching a 'why_retrieved' tag to every result and includes a self-directing loop to resolve knowledge gaps. It is embedded by default and supports owner-scoping for multi-user environments like Discord.
entries.ccf/agentcairn: AgentCairn uses an Obsidian vault as the source of truth, storing memory as inspectable Markdown files without opaque databases. It utilizes DuckDB as a replaceable retrieval cache to support coding agents like Claude Code and Codex.
entries.yepyhun/Brainstack: Brainstack is a memory kernel that integrates Hindsight, Graphiti, and MemPalace into a single owner for Hermes agents. It manages state and retrieval using SQLite, Kuzu, and Chroma to deliver purpose-built evidence packets for each query.
entries.amanning3390/flowstate-qmd: This anticipatory memory system prefetches context by monitoring agent session logs and stores data locally using SQLite-vec. It is an MCP-native server designed for automated configuration with major coding agent clients.
entries.Perseus-Computing-LLC/perseus: Perseus resolves live workspace state into verified facts before the context window opens, resulting in up to 94% fewer prompt tokens. It uses SQLite and FTS5 for local-first storage and integrates via MCP-native stdio or SSE servers.
entries.generalbusiness-ai/keep: Keep provides reflective memory through semantic search, BM25 full-text indexing, and ranked graph traversal. It features automated indexing for codebases and multimedia, using edge tags to create bidirectional relationships between notes.
entries.alias8818/hermes-tool-slimmer: This plugin reduces prompt token overhead by using local BM25 ranking to select relevant tool schemas. It includes a dashboard for tracking estimated savings and is compatible with Hermes Agent v0.14.0 native tool search.
entries.Ladybug-Memory/hermes-memory-plugin: This local-only provider uses an embedded graph database to surface high-priority memories via importance-weighted recall. It supports BM25 keyword search, named graph relationships, and optional GLiNER2 entity extraction.
entries.conorbronsdon/claude-context-os: This tool provides a Git-backed context layer that uses Markdown files as a durable source of truth for project instructions and chats. It features a migration workflow for importing data and supports Claude Code, Codex, and OpenClaw.
entries.MukundaKatta/hermes-agentmemory: This episodic memory plugin features an on-demand summarizer and supports immediate, real event deletion to prevent persistent summaries from affecting future recall. It provides a trace.jsonl audit log to track every prefetch and memory operation.
entries.piprail/piprail: This SDK and MCP server enables agents to handle payments across 29 chains, including EVM and Solana, with 0% transaction fees. It allows Hermes agents to settle payments directly to wallets using USDC and other stablecoins.
entries.stepanov1975/hermes-local-knowledge: This plugin indexes local skills, scripts, and MCP configurations to provide tools for artifact search and graph neighbor traversal. It utilizes implicit and explicit feedback to improve the accuracy of local routing hints.
entries.yonro/hermes-xmemo-plugin: This provider enables durable cross-session memory through pre-turn context injection and session-end snapshots. It includes a local SQLite reliability layer and a write outbox for searching and updating agent state.
entries.futurebrowser/hermes-exabase-plugin: Integrating Exabase M-1, this plugin provides self-organizing long-term memory with tools for manual storage and search. It supports configurable query expansion and result reranking to optimize retrieval performance.
entries.visorcraft/MongrelDB-Hermes: This AI-native memory solution offers AES-256-GCM encryption at rest and supports HNSW ANN, sparse, and FM-index retrieval. It can be executed via native Rust FFI or as an HTTP daemon and includes MinHash deduplication.
entries.sourcevault-ai/sourcevault-code-tools: This plugin provides private local code memory for repositories, requiring a local SourceVault server for indexing and vector storage. It adds deterministic slash commands and LLM-callable tools for semantic search and grounded Q&A.
entries.penfieldlabs/hermes-penfield: This suite offers 17 tools for memory management and knowledge graph traversal using a hybrid of BM25, vector, and graph search methods. It also features automatic context checkpointing during message compression.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-memory-kit: This file-based toolkit uses a git-backed directory to manage versioned Markdown memories without a database. It includes specialized 'rot' and 'lint' curators to identify and resolve stale or conflicting data through evidence-cited diffs.

entries.obra/superpowers: This framework implements a subagent-driven development process to facilitate autonomous task execution. It enforces test-driven development and YAGNI principles while integrating as a plugin for various coding harnesses and CLIs.
entries.nexu-io/open-design: This local-first design and prototyping system generates documents and decks using real CSS and components. It supports macOS and Windows desktop applications and integrates with DeepSeek Harness, Claude Code, and OpenAI-compatible endpoints.
entries.mukul975/Anthropic-Cybersecurity-Skills: This repository provides 818 structured skills across 34 security domains, mapped to frameworks including MITRE ATT&CK, ATLAS, and D3FEND. The library is compatible with over 26 AI platforms for comprehensive security operations.

entries.internet-court/internet-court-skill: Serving as a trust layer for agent-to-agent commerce, this skill provides a master router for delegated permissions, escrow, and dispute resolution. It includes vendored protocol skills to facilitate secure transactions and verification.
entries.conorbronsdon/avoid-ai-writing: This utility audits and rewrites content to eliminate detectable AI patterns using five optional voice profiles. It is compatible with agentskills.io-compliant platforms, including Claude Code and Hermes.
entries.AMAP-ML/SkillClaw: This project unifies isolated skill silos into a shared, evolving library that natively integrates with Hermes and OpenClaw. It includes a bilingual dashboard for inspecting session traces and monitoring collective skill evolution.
entries.wondelai/skills: This cross-platform library offers 51 expert frameworks and 14 guided metaskills compatible with agent-plugins.org specifications. It maintains session state within the project's documentation directory to support persistent agent workflows.
entries.mohitagw15856/pm-claude-skills: This collection features 1,153 skills with native support for Hermes Agent and Claude Code, plus ready-to-paste exports for other assistants. It includes specific integrations for platforms such as Slack, Telegram, Raycast, and Obsidian.
entries.ZeroPointRepo/youtube-skills: This skill set enables Hermes Agent and other platforms to perform video searches and extract transcripts, channel data, and playlists. It requires a TranscriptAPI key and supports tools like OpenClaw, Cursor, and Windsurf.
entries.Romanescu11/hermes-skill-factory: This meta-skill plugin monitors active workflows to automatically detect and propose reusable skills. It generates both SKILL.md documentation and Python scaffolds, allowing users to manage detected patterns via slash commands.
entries.Cranot/super-hermes: This project teaches Hermes Agent to generate its own custom thinking instructions and analytical prompts for specific tasks. It utilizes pre-built analytical lenses and generates reports that highlight potential analysis blind spots.
entries.DougTrajano/pydantic-ai-skills: This project provides type-safe support for modular packages containing instructions, resources, and scripts. It implements progressive disclosure to improve prompt efficiency and supports both programmatic skills and remote registries.
entries.AkoliteZA/hermes-agent-idea-workflow: This skill set converts rough concepts into structured design and implementation documents through Lite and Full modes. It includes a specialized spec review gate that utilizes PASS/FAIL evaluation models to ensure project quality.
entries.tlehman/litprog-skill: This literate programming skill weaves prose, diagrams, and source code into .lit.md files. It features a tangler to extract runnable source files and automatically syncs edits from those files back into the primary documentation.
entries.ReinaMacCredy/maestro: Designed for long-running agents, this harness uses a mechanism kernel and Markdown-based recipes to manage work through durable trees and layered proof verification. It implements the SLP cooperative-agent protocol to facilitate supervised team workflows.
entries.esaradev/icarus-plugin: This plugin enables cross-instance shared memory via markdown files to capture high-value decisions and outcomes. It provides a pipeline for fine-tuning and switching to replacement models based on recorded work history.
entries.smartcontractkit/chainlink-agent-skills: This collection provides interoperable skills following the agentskills.io specification for interacting with oracle networks and smart contracts. It supports integration with CCIP, VRF, Data Feeds, and specialized CRE and ACE services.
entries.Hermes-brasil/hermes-brasil: This community resource offers installation guides and skills formatted in SKILL.md specifically for Portuguese-speaking users. It adheres to the agentskills.io standard to ensure compatibility within the Hermes Agent ecosystem.
entries.black-forest-labs/skills: These official skills provide specialized prompting guidelines and API integration for FLUX image and video generation. The project includes a router to manage multi-step video workflows using Python and TypeScript clients.
entries.armelhbobdad/bmad-module-skill-forge: This tool converts repositories, documentation, and developer discourse into version-pinned instruction files compliant with agentskills.io. It links instructions directly to source lines and provides lifecycle tooling for creating and testing new skills.
entries.chigwell/skilldock.io: This registry facilitates the discovery and installation of reusable AI skills with recursive dependency resolution. It features a Python client and CLI, alongside commerce capabilities powered by TON payments.
entries.tiann/execplan-skill: This skill enables autonomous execution of complex multi-step tasks with real-time progress tracking. It ensures operational safety through built-in checkpoints and rollback procedures for recovery from failures.
entries.supernovae-st/nika: Nika is a local-first workflow language that uses a single Rust binary to execute AI tasks based on four verbs. It prioritizes security and transparency by auditing cost ceilings and secret flows while generating hash-chained receipts for verifiable run history.
entries.adnw-vinc/hermes-nextcloud: This skill enables Hermes Agent to manage files, notes, calendars, tasks, and contacts through standard WebDAV and CalDAV protocols. It ensures secure communication via HTTPS using Nextcloud App Passwords and includes a guided script for credential validation.
entries.cablate/Agentic-MCP-Skill: This progressive MCP client utilizes a three-layer lazy loading architecture to minimize token usage during agent interactions. It features a socket-based daemon for persistent connections and supports incremental discovery of server metadata and tool schemas.
entries.willingning-coder/eagle-eye: Eagle-eye implements a five-layer retrieval system using hard triggers, semantic embeddings, and RRF fusion to narrow skill lists before LLM calls. The system is designed to reduce token consumption and offers graceful degradation if embedding models or specific dependencies are unavailable.
entries.amanning3390/hermeshub: Serving as a community hub for skill discovery, this project implements the Agentic Resource Discovery (ARD) v0.9 specification for one-click installations. It operates autonomously on NVIDIA infrastructure and provides federated search across GitHub and Hugging Face.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermaguard: This skill performs adversarial code reviews by deploying three parallel subagents to identify edge cases and integration issues without modifying the source. It combines deterministic pre-scans using tools like Semgrep and Bandit with verified findings through proof-of-concept execution in a hardened sandbox.
entries.EntangledQuantum/Life_OS: Life_OS is an ADHD-friendly execution system where an agent manages system design while the user completes tasks via a tapping interface. It stores data locally using SQLite and connects to AI agents specifically through the Model Context Protocol.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-multichannel-prompt-opt: This plugin optimizes prompts across multiple interfaces, including CLI, Discord, and Telegram, while reducing token usage by 20–80%. It supports 97 languages via langid integration and evaluates prompt quality across five distinct dimensions.
entries.Sahil-SS9/hermes-simplify-swarm: Inspired by Claude Code, this skill uses parallel subagents focused on hygiene, clarity, and correctness to simplify code in five programming languages. It employs a risk-tiered application process that requires an approval gate before changes are finalized.
entries.teixeirazeus/fablize-for-hermes: This project adapts verified procedures for task decomposition, utilizing mandatory evidence-based verification gates and a systematic investigation protocol. It includes a Python goal engine to maintain persistent task states and prevent early-stop errors during debugging.
entries.PederHP/skillsdotnet: This C# and .NET implementation of the agentskills.io pattern enables tool-based skill loading through Microsoft.Extensions.AI. It supports progressive disclosure via SKILL.md files and automates the registration of common agent skill directories.
entries.handnewb/hermes-cybersec-lab: This turnkey laboratory provides Hermes Agent with over 2,000 skills and 131 tools for network forensics and exploitation. It integrates 28 cybersecurity frameworks and standards, covering real-world exploits ranging from 2015 to 2026.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skills: These production-tested skills add session management and worktree recovery to provide memory between agent conversations. The toolkit also orchestrates parallel subagents for architectural reviews and includes utilities for detecting state drift.
entries.conorbronsdon/demo-gif-skill: This skill automates the creation of reproducible repository demos by generating recording scripts with vhs or Playwright. It optimizes resulting GIF files to remain under 8 MB and embeds them directly into the project's README.
entries.conorbronsdon/agent-skill-builder: This tool generates Claude Code and portable agent skills from plain language while preventing technical debt through frontmatter validation. It monitors official specifications weekly to detect drift and uses CI-friendly exit codes to report profile mismatches.
entries.Carlo1911/skill-evolution: This project implements a self-improvement loop that analyzes session history to identify skill coverage gaps and propose structured updates. It operates locally using the Python standard library and gates all changes behind deterministic and LLM-judge evaluation frameworks.
entries.aidevelopers2/remoteopenclaw-mcp: This CLI and MCP server enables agents to search a database of over 13,870 MCP servers and 4,384 skills. It facilitates tool discovery and provides direct installation commands for compatible clients like Hermes, Cursor, and Claude Code.
entries.Diabloluo/hermes-hud: This local-first dashboard provides real-time observability for Hermes Agent across 11 monitoring tabs, including token costs and error tracking. It maintains a strict read-only boundary with zero outbound telemetry and supports incident alerts via Telegram or Feishu.
entries.CorsenAI/hermes-windows-runtime-skills: These skills enable deterministic path routing and Python interpreter selection across Windows, Git Bash, and WSL environments. The tool ensures project compatibility by verifying existing runtimes without requiring new installations.
entries.mag3nt-com/openclaw-skill: This skill automates USDC payments for HTTP 402 responses using protocols such as x402, MPP, and AP2. It is designed for compatibility with the OpenClaw and Hermes Agent standards to facilitate machine-to-machine transactions.
entries.skillseal/skillseal: This framework certifies the quality of AI agent skills by testing their structure, functionality, and security within isolated Docker containers. It issues cryptographically verifiable Ed25519 certificates and provides a public API for skill submission and verification.
entries.webmilmind1/hermes-bounty-board: This plugin allows users to earn USDC on the Base network by resolving support bounties without requiring accounts or API keys. It includes tools for managing bounty boards and buying context, with payments settled after human approval.
entries.Shine8592/china-briefing: This news briefing generator produces structured reports ranging from global to street-level geographic scales. It utilizes semantic memory to integrate user interests and applies quality gates to AI-generated analysis and action suggestions.
entries.jiawood2006/hermes-skills: This collection provides specialized utilities for video-to-text conversion, document OCR, and AI writing refinement. The tools are compatible with the agentskills.io standard and support deployment on macOS and Linux systems.
entries.scavio-ai/hermes-agent: This project provides access to structured web data across 31 platforms through an MCP server exposing 191 tools. It includes five production-grade workflow skills compatible with Hermes, Claude, and Cursor.

entries.numtide/llm-agents.nix: This project provides Nix packages for AI coding agents including Hermes, ensuring tools are automatically updated on a daily basis. It offers a reliable way to manage development tools from various providers within the Nix ecosystem.
entries.marshallrichards/ClawPhone: This repository features an automated installer and configuration guides for running Hermes Agent and Antigravity CLI on ARM64 Android devices via Termux. It enables hardware and UI access through Termux:API and Termux:GUI integrations.
entries.AbuZar-Ansarii/Hermes-Agent-On-Android: Designed for mobile users, this project offers a one-line installation script to deploy Hermes Agent within Termux environments on Android. It supports over 70 tools, persistent memory, and the ability to connect to local models via Ollama.
entries.ultraworkers/hermes-agent-helm-chart: This community Helm chart facilitates the deployment of Hermes Agent on Kubernetes with a focus on cloud-native state safety. It enforces single-writer access for persistent storage and supports both direct deployments and operator-ready workflows.
entries.amirghm/hermes-agent-mobile: This one-command installer brings Hermes to both Android and iOS devices using Termux and iSH. It distinguishes itself by integrating with Telegram for voice and file messaging and supporting scheduled tasks via cron jobs.
entries.TheAiSingularity/hermesclaw: This deployment option focuses on security by providing hardware-enforced sandboxing for Hermes Agent via NVIDIA OpenShell. It implements kernel-level restrictions on network and filesystem access alongside configurable security policies.
entries.solomon2773/nora: Nora is a self-hosted control plane for operating Hermes agents on Docker or Kubernetes with built-in monitoring for metrics and costs. It includes LLM budget caps and provides multiple interfaces including a REST API, CLI, and MCP server.
entries.xmbshwll/hermes-agent-docker: This project provides a straightforward Docker sandbox image that includes the official Hermes installation and mini-swe-agent. It supports persistent state through mounted directories and allows users to build specific versions using build arguments.
entries.0xrsydn/nix-hermes-agent: This NixOS module enables reproducible, declarative deployments of Hermes with secure secrets integration via sops-nix. It features a hybrid skill management system that supports both Nix-managed and CLI-installed skills.
entries.jpalmae/hermeshq: HermesHQ is a Docker-first control plane that manages multiple agent instances with separate workspaces and RBAC-controlled access. It is unique for supporting inter-agent delegation with hierarchy-aware communication and enterprise MCP access.
entries.JackTheGit/hermes-autonomous-server: Targeting production environments, this project configures the Hermes Gateway as a reboot-safe systemd service for headless operation on Ubuntu and Debian. It is designed for autonomous execution of recurring AI cron jobs and integrates with Nous Portal.
entries.MilkyWay008/Hermes-OTG: This portable distribution allows Hermes to run from a USB drive or any external storage without requiring host installation or registry writes. It bundles Python, PortableGit, and rescue tools to support Desktop, TUI, and Gateway modes in isolated environments.

entries.TauricResearch/TradingAgents: This framework deploys specialized agents for fundamental, sentiment, and technical financial analysis. It utilizes a researcher team to conduct bullish and bearish debates, overseen by risk management and portfolio manager agents for final approvals.
entries.builderz-labs/mission-control: This self-hosted orchestration platform governs agent registration, memory browsing, and cost tracking across Web UI, CLI, and REST API interfaces. It supports multi-agent workflows and can be installed locally via Node.js or deployed using Docker.
entries.agent-of-empires/agent-of-empires: This control surface manages multiple coding agents, including Hermes Agent, through TUI and web dashboards. It ensures persistent sessions via tmux integration and provides sandboxing through Docker, Podman, and Apple Containers.
entries.CryptoDmitry/hermes-agent-control-room: This execution engine manages Hermes agents and specialist teams using the Claude-style MCP protocol in stdio mode. It is the first MCP engine on the Solana blockchain and features HTTP signal detection to handle payment-required states for APIs.
entries.shannhk/hermes-agent-control-room: This template uses a level-based architecture and task bus pattern to scale Hermes Agent from single VPS instances to automated teams. It includes bundled skills for specialized operations such as security auditing, backup management, and VPS provisioning.
entries.swarmclawai/swarmclaw: This framework builds autonomous agent swarms with durable memory and MCP tool integration across more than 23 LLM providers. It features visual org charts to help users manage agent team delegation and orchestration.
entries.agent37-platform/minions: This mission control interface allows users to supervise autonomous Hermes Agent work through a centralized Kanban board and review queue. It provides live streaming of agent reasoning and requires human-in-the-loop verification for all proposed task completions.
entries.1ilkhamov/opencode-hermes-multiagent: This project coordinates 17 specialized AI agents focused on research, planning, implementation, quality, and infrastructure. It utilizes a strict pipeline architecture managed by a Master Orchestrator for precise routing and coordination.
entries.linke-ai/hermes-agent-team: This local collaboration system orchestrates Leader and Specialist agents using MCP and ACP protocols for tool and communication handling. It features a real-time Web UI for monitoring agent dialogues and task flows via Hermes Kanban.
entries.howdymary/hermes-agent-metaharness: This meta-harness automates the outer-loop optimization of benchmark code for Hermes Agent. It orchestrates TBLite and TerminalBench-2 evaluations while providing structured candidate mutation and frontier tracking.
entries.runtimenoteslabs/gladiator: This agent-vs-agent arena orchestrates nine autonomous agents across two competing AI companies. It uses Paperclip and Hermes Agent for task execution and learning, visualized through a real-time dashboard and scoreboard.
entries.InfiniteWhispers/HermesAgent-MultiModel: This fully-local framework implements a Mixture-of-Agents stack optimized for consumer GPUs like the RTX 4080/5080. It uses Hermes for task routing and tool-calling while performing parallel model querying and synthesis via Ollama.

entries.colbymchenry/codegraph: This tool maintains a 100% local, pre-indexed code knowledge graph that automatically synchronizes as files change to minimize token usage and tool calls. It provides structural extraction for languages like TypeScript and Python, integrating directly with Hermes Agent to enhance its codebase awareness.
entries.junhoyeo/tokscale: Tokscale is a CLI utility and 3D visualization dashboard designed to track token consumption across various AI coding agents and IDEs. It allows developers to monitor usage data from Hermes Agent and other tools, with options to submit statistics to a public leaderboard.
entries.liaohch3/claude-tap: This local trace viewer enables the inspection of API traffic from coding agents, including Hermes Agent, while automatically redacting authentication headers. It exports session data into self-contained HTML files for detailed debugging and analysis of agent communications.
entries.Javis603/token-monitor: This widget provides real-time tracking of tokens, costs, and rate limits by reading the state of Hermes Agent and other CLI tools directly. It supports multi-device synchronization, allowing developers to monitor account limits and session details across different machines.
entries.bergside/typeui: TypeUI offers design systems and layout guidance through MCP servers to assist in building user interfaces with AI. It integrates with Hermes Agent and other providers to deliver structured UI development support via markdown or general prompting.
entries.Salomondiei08/oh-my-hermes: This project functions as an opinionated workflow layer that coordinates seven specialized agents and 36 skills for building and operating applications. It supports autonomous execution on laptops or VPS environments, specifically tailored for Hermes Agent users.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-skins: Hermes-skins provides a collection of community-created themes and CLI skins to customize the terminal UI of Hermes Agent. Users can modify ASCII art, spinners, and banner colors using a YAML-based configuration system.
entries.AlexAI-MCP/hermes-CCC: This port brings the Hermes Agent brain and 46 native skills directly into the Claude Code Channel without requiring external processes or OAuth. It includes specialized MLOps tools for GGUF inference, vLLM, and reinforcement learning training.
entries.tinyhumansai/tiny.place: This platform establishes a social economy for autonomous agents by providing encrypted messaging via the Signal Protocol and identity registration with human-readable handles. It enables Hermes Agent and others to conduct commerce using Solana-based USDC and SOL payments.
entries.unmodeled-tyler/vessel-browser: Vessel is an AI-native browser designed for autonomous agent control through the Model Context Protocol (MCP). It features a supervisor sidebar for managing workflows and includes an undo function to revert recent changes made by an agent.
entries.topoteretes/cognee-integrations: This project provides a memory layer for various frameworks and includes a plugin for Claude Code that enables automatic context recall. It extends agent capabilities through chat bot integrations for platforms like Slack, Telegram, and VS Code.
entries.adityahimaone/hermes-agent-rtk-caveman: This setup utilizes RTK and Caveman templating to achieve 90-99% token savings during agent operations. It comes with over 40 pre-configured skills for research, finance, and devops, featuring an automated installer for Linux and macOS.
entries.Abruptive/Ankh.md: This framework enables the creation of scoped Hermes Agents through per-folder configurations and project-local memories. It allows users to switch between default and scoped agents while maintaining specific skills and custom instructions for individual directories.
entries.42-evey/evey-setup: This tool provides automated installation for the hermes-agent stack and over 12 supporting services across three scalable deployment tiers. It facilitates rapid setup with support for 29 community plugins across six functional categories at zero cost.
entries.hermes-labs-ai/lintlang: A static linter that performs local, deterministic checks on AI agent configurations and system prompts without using LLMs. It identifies vague tool descriptions and missing retry budgets while integrating directly with Hermes Agent verification hooks.
entries.0xNyk/openclaw-to-hermes: This migration utility transitions OpenClaw assets, including SOUL.md and memory archives, into Hermes-compatible YAML and JSON formats. It automates the setup of systemd gateway services and manages the conversion of nested authentication structures.
entries.observeco/observeco: This self-healing observability tool offers passive monitoring and active probing for multi-agent systems without cloud dependencies. It includes a native Hermes Agent plugin for real-time telemetry and establishes baselines by watching local configuration files.
entries.33hodl/hermes-startup: This local-first skill uses dynamic slash commands and a deterministic runtime to help users generate income via Hermes Agent. It prioritizes security by requiring explicit approval for all external actions and utilizing a bounded JSON adapter.
entries.handnewb/hermes-voice: This offline voice assistant enables hands-free interaction with Hermes Agent using wake-word detection and adaptive turn-taking. It supports 35 languages and operates entirely locally without the need for API keys or external accounts.
entries.181079342/hermes-memoss: A memory plugin for Hermes that provides tools for semantic search and multi-dimensional storage. It features a built-in circuit breaker to maintain stability during MemOS API outages while managing memory addition and deletion.

entries.farion1231/cc-switch: This cross-platform manager, built with Tauri 2, serves as an all-in-one desktop interface for Hermes Agent alongside other tools like Claude Code and Gemini CLI. It provides a unified management solution compatible with Windows, macOS, and Linux systems.
entries.iOfficeAI/AionUi: AionUi is a local open-source coworking application that consolidates dozens of external agents, including Hermes Agent, into a single interface. The platform features 21 built-in professional assistants and enables remote access through a WebUI and various messaging platforms.
entries.nesquena/hermes-webui: Developed using Python and vanilla JavaScript, this web-based interface allows users to access Hermes Agent from browsers or mobile devices. It includes a circular context ring for monitoring token usage and supports secure remote access via SSH tunnels.
entries.fathah/hermes-desktop: This desktop companion app simplifies the initial experience with Hermes Agent through guided installation and provider setup. It offers a graphical user interface for managing chat sessions, tools, and multiple AI providers.
entries.EKKOLearnAI/hermes-studio: This web dashboard provides a visual workflow canvas with approval gates and unified configuration for 10 messaging platforms like Telegram and Discord. It tracks token consumption and execution history while storing session data in a local SQLite database.
entries.outsourc-e/hermes-workspace: This native web workspace features a Swarm Mode with role-based dispatch and tmux-backed workers for complex tasks. It integrates a Monaco-based file browser, a PTY terminal, and specialized managers for memory, skills, and MCP catalogs.
entries.xintaofei/codeg: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent workspace that aggregates sessions from Hermes and other coding agents into a desktop or self-hosted environment. It supports custom ACP-compatible agent registration and offers native iOS and Android clients for mobile access.
entries.dodo-reach/hermes-desktop: Designed as a native Mac workspace, this tool provides direct local or SSH connections to Hermes hosts with an embedded terminal for shell access. It features native views for organizing sessions, Kanban boards, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.Eynzof/Hermes-CN-Desktop: Built with Tauri, TypeScript, and Rust, this Windows-first desktop application includes a built-in kernel for local agent execution. The interface supports native file dialogs, memory management, and rendering for LaTeX and Mermaid diagrams.
entries.abundantbeing/hermes-browser-extension: This Chromium side-panel extension connects a local or remote Hermes runtime directly to the active browser context. It features site-aware drafting in 31 environments and live browser control governed by explicit user approval gates.
entries.uzairansaruzi/hermex: Hermex is a native SwiftUI iPhone app that allows users to drive a self-hosted Hermes agent from their phone by pairing with a hermes-webui server. It enables real-time chat and server file system browsing without the use of subscriptions or third-party relays.
entries.freestylefly/wesight: This desktop workspace offers one-click setup for Hermes Agent and other engines, featuring a runtime dashboard to track latency and token usage. It provides a live workspace specifically designed for monitoring code writes and diffs in real time.
entries.joeynyc/hermes-hud: This interactive TUI serves as a consciousness monitor for Hermes, featuring nine tabs and four selectable color themes. It provides a tmux operator view for managing live agent panes while tracking agent growth, git projects, and scheduled cron jobs.
entries.xaspx/hermes-control-interface: This self-hosted web dashboard provides a browser-based terminal, file explorer, and system metrics behind a secure login. It features real-time chat with tool call visualization, an MCP server control plane, and a ZOO Swarm Monitor for tracking agent health and kanban pipelines.
entries.jazzyalex/agent-sessions: A native macOS session browser and cockpit that tracks live quota burn for Codex and Claude across 14+ agent formats. It operates entirely locally with no telemetry, offering searchable transcripts and image browsing without uploading session history.
entries.nickvasilescu/hermes-desktop-os1: This native macOS interface connects to Orgo cloud VMs and SSH hosts, offering one-click automated Hermes Agent installation on fresh cloud computers. It integrates a WebRTC voice mode utilizing OpenAI Realtime and Orgo MCP for hands-free interaction.
entries.sharbelxyz/hermes-agent-mission-control: Built with Next.js 16 and Tailwind CSS v4, this dashboard template uses a Postgres message bus to bridge local agents with a web interface. It includes a specialized approval inbox for managing agent requests that trigger side effects.
entries.liftaris/herm: Built with OpenTUI, this alternative interface provides a text-based environment for chatting and managing Hermes Agent sessions. It includes a kanban board for task management and tools for configuring profiles, skills, and cron jobs.
entries.clawvader-tech/hermes-telegram-miniapp: This mobile-first React SPA dashboard functions as a Telegram Mini App with support for five concurrent background agent instances. It features terminal chat with streaming responses and utilizes dual HMAC-SHA256 and Ed25519 authentication for Telegram validation.
entries.aivrar/portable-hermes-agent: This portable Windows desktop application requires no installation, Docker, or admin rights to run Hermes with local or cloud models. It includes a dynamic tool maker for API and Python handlers alongside integrated support for TTS, Music, and ComfyUI workflows.
entries.pyrate-llama/hermes-ui: This glassmorphic web interface provides real-time log streaming and chat for self-hosted AI assistants. Users can manage skills, cron jobs, and MCP servers through an integrated file browser and task tracking dashboard.
entries.sanchomuzax/hermes-webui: This monitoring dashboard provides real-time tracking of session activity and costs for Hermes deployments. It allows for full inspection of conversation histories and skill source code, alongside read-only monitoring of environment variables.
entries.Euraika-Labs/pan-ui: A chat-first workspace featuring real-time SSE streaming and tool approval cards for secure agent execution. It includes an integrated marketplace for discovering MCP servers and isolated profile management for separate sessions and API keys.
entries.Felix-Forever/hermes-agent-desktop: This native desktop client orchestrates collaboration between 20 specialized AI agents and supports model switching. It features a Visual Skill Store with over 50 curated one-click installations and streaming SSE chat responses.
